name: 13068 · Freeville, NY
findings: ZIP 13068 (Freeville) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (71%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13068 (Freeville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13068 (Freeville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
